title: UserProfile
description: BibleFi user profile record representing an individual or organization participating in the BibleFi ecosystem.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the user_profile schema used.

display_name.description: Public display name for this user.

role.description: User's role within the BibleFi ecosystem.

email.description: Email address for notifications and account recovery.

avatar_uri.description: URI pointing to the user's avatar image.

bio.description: Short biographical description of the user.

church_id.description: UUID reference to the user's affiliated church_record.

wallet_addresses.description: EVM wallet addresses associated with this user.

on_chain_alerts.description: Whether on-chain event alerts are enabled.

verified.description: Whether this user account has been verified by the BibleFi protocol.

tags.description: Searchable tags associated with this user.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this account was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent profile update.
